messages.en: Which trousers are you wearing tonight?
Just the black ones. I ironed them earlier.

senses.en_definition: The whole of; all of; including every part or member.

messages.en: Is your power out too? I thought it was just my house.
Yeah, the whole neighbourhood has no power. The neighbour down the other end says their house is dark too.
Oh, no wonder the streetlights are out too. I'll go find a torch.

senses.en_definition: Increasingly; to a greater degree as time passes or conditions change.

messages.en: It's raining harder and harder. I'll wait at the bus stop for now. Where are you?
I'm just sheltering outside a shop. Stay there. I'll come over once the rain eases up a bit.

senses.en_definition: Last night; the night before today.

collocations.en: went to bed late last night

senses.en_definition: For one night; lasting a single night.

messages.en: Have you got the photos from our meal last night? I want to save them.
I already sent them to the group after I got home last night, remember? Have another look.
Ah, found them! There were so many messages, I missed them.
